label: Optimizing-giving laws and a tied-optimum model, checked
description: Premise-free laws and model for the NAR graft batch (G3). Sense-mixing control: it relates the optimality, output-profile, NECESSITATE_5 and NECESSARY_2 senses without a bridge premise. Laws 2 and 3 use #1737's certificate through its Lean theorem. The tied model shows that G1 needs the uniqueness clause: with two optimal candidates the root can be two-way toward a contingent while giving only optimal candidates at every world where it exists. Establishes no premise.
